We should be able to see it and the Skull Queen's fortress when we get to the top of this hill.|Klay Firewell and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name=":1">''[[Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls]]''</ref>}}
'''Mount Octan''' was a [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] on the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]]-[[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nallastia]] that housed the [[Skull Queen's fortress|fortress]] of the ruling [[Skull Queen]], [[Quenelle]] (who, as the contemporary [[Margravine]], also served as the [[Fondorian]] [[Satellite/Legends|satellite's]] [[Politics/Legends|political]] ruler).

The mount, whose conical top "impaled the heavens,"<ref name=":1" /> was named for the [[Nallastian]]s' founder, the [[Margrave Octan]], a descendant of the [[Royal Octans]]—a ruling family of the [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector]], whose traditions of wealth and [[Noble/Legends|position]] extended back to the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], to the [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] before [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]. The Margrave's legendary power gems, the [[Lost Stars of Nallastia]], were hidden deep within Mount Octan, in its [[Cavern of Screaming Skulls]].<ref name=":0">''[[Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner]]''</ref><ref name=":1" />

It was in the grassy foothills of Mount Octan that an 18-year-old [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], crash-landed a [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]] that he'd borrowed from [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Rodd]] while on a [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]] [[Mission to Fondor (Separatist Crisis)|mission to Fondor]]. Many dangerous creatures, such as the [[poison]]ous [[venrap]] [[Snake/Legends|snake]] and the wild [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[grillik]], lived in the foothills, but it was here that Skywalker met and befriended [[Klay Firewell]], an 11-year-old boy from [[Corulag]] whose [[Zoologist/Legends|zoologist]] [[Hondu Firewell|parents]] were seized by the [[Nallastian]] [[Prince/Legends|princess]] [[Calvaria]] and [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] within an [[Force field/Legends|energy field]] for trespassing. Skywalker bargained for their release and helped in the search for the ancient power gems that would free them.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" />
